jlt_worldz.single_biome.title: Customize Worldz: Single Biome
jlt_worldz.single_biome.starter_biome: Starter biome (empty = same as land biome)

jlt_worldz.single_biome.allow_beaches: Allow natural beaches and stony shores to generate
jlt_worldz.chaos_biomes.title: Customize Worldz: Chaos Biomes
jlt_worldz.chaos_biomes.biomes: Weighted land biomes (id or id@weight, one per line)
jlt_worldz.chaos_biomes.starter_biome: Starter biome (empty = chaos starts at spawn)
jlt_worldz.chaos_biomes.allow_oceans: Allow natural rivers and oceans to generate
jlt_worldz.chaos_biomes.allow_beaches: Allow natural beaches and stony shores to generate
jlt_worldz.strip_world.title: Customize Worldz: Strip World
jlt_worldz.strip_world.apply_to_nether: Apply the same corridor width to the Nether
jlt_worldz.strip_world.bands_enabled: Pass through an ordered biome-band sequence
jlt_worldz.strip_world.band_biomes: Band biomes, in order (one per line)
jlt_worldz.strip_world.band_seed_random_: Shuffle the band order once (fixed for this world)
jlt_worldz.strip_world.band_allow_rivers: Allow natural rivers to pass through the bands
jlt_worldz.strip_world.band_allow_oceans: Allow natural rivers and oceans to pass through the bands
jlt_worldz.strip_world.band_allow_beache: Allow natural beaches and stony shores to pass through the bands
jlt_worldz.ocean_island.title: Customize Worldz: Ocean Island
jlt_worldz.ocean_island.ocean_shallow_de: Shallow seabed depth below sea level
jlt_worldz.ocean_island.ocean_deep_depth: Deep seabed depth below sea level
jlt_worldz.ocean_island.ocean_region_sca: Ocean biome region size in blocks
jlt_worldz.ocean_island.exclusion_zone_e: Release shaping beyond an exclusion zone (distant natural islands)
jlt_worldz.sky_island.title: Customize Worldz: Sky Island
jlt_worldz.sky_island.apply_to_nether: Also make the Nether a sky island
jlt_worldz.sky_island.thickness: Slab thickness in blocks below the surface
jlt_worldz.sky_island.exclusion_zone_ena: Biome-pinning buffer beyond the starter island
jlt_worldz.sky_island.exclusion_zone_rad: Buffer radius in blocks beyond the island's edge
jlt_worldz.sky_island.floating_islands_e: Scattered floating islands beyond the starter island
jlt_worldz.sky_island.floating_cell_size: Grid-cell size in blocks (how far apart islands are)
jlt_worldz.sky_island.floating_spawn_cha: Chance (0–1) a grid cell holds an island
jlt_worldz.sky_island.floating_biome_var: Vary scattered-island biomes instead of sharing the starter island's
jlt_worldz.sky_island.floating_natural_b: Use each scattered island's real seed biome instead (overrides biome variety)
jlt_worldz.sky_island.floating_island_bi: Scattered-island biome pool (one per line or comma-separated)
jlt_worldz.sky_island.floating_exclusion: Void buffer before scattered islands begin
jlt_worldz.sky_island.floating_ore_depos: Embed one ore deposit on each scattered island
jlt_worldz.sky_island.floating_loot_ches: Place one loot chest on each scattered island
jlt_worldz.sky_chunk.title: Customize Worldz: Sky Chunk
jlt_worldz.sky_chunk.spawn_chance: Chance (0-1) a grid cell holds a chunk island
jlt_worldz.sky_chunk.cell_size_chunks: Grid-cell size in chunks (how far apart islands are)
jlt_worldz.sky_chunk.top_only: Keep only the top slice of each island, void below
jlt_worldz.sky_chunk.top_only_depth: Depth kept below the surface in blocks (e.g. 5 for access to stone)
jlt_worldz.sky_chunk.exclusion_zone_enab: Void buffer before scattered islands begin
jlt_worldz.sky_chunk.scattered_top_only_: Chance (0-1) a scattered island independently keeps only its top slice
jlt_worldz.sky_chunk.apply_to_nether: Also make the Nether use chunk islands
jlt_worldz.sky_chunk.apply_to_end: Also make the End use chunk islands
jlt_worldz.cave.title: Customize Worldz: Cave
jlt_worldz.cave.spawn_depth_y: Spawn depth (target Y for the underground cavity search)
jlt_worldz.cave.sealed_surface: Seal the surface (solid roof, no sky access)
jlt_worldz.nether_start.title: Customize Worldz: Nether Start
jlt_worldz.nether_start.spawn_y: Spawn depth (target Y for the safe-site search)
jlt_worldz.end_start.title: Customize Worldz: End Start
jlt_worldz.flat.title: Customize Worldz: Flat
jlt_worldz.flat.layers: Layers (bottom to top, one per line: block or block:height)
jlt_worldz.flat.structure_overrides: Eligible structure sets (one per line, empty = all)
jlt_worldz.deep_flat.title: Customize Worldz: Deep Flat
jlt_worldz.deep_flat.cap_layers: Cap layers (bottom to top, one per line: block or block:height)
jlt_worldz.deep_flat.rivers_enabled: Rivers/oceans show as water at the surface
jlt_worldz.stacked.title: Customize Worldz: Stacked
jlt_worldz.stacked.layers: Layers (bottom to top, one per line: biome;blocks;air gap, or just a biome id for standard defaults)
jlt_worldz.stacked.relief_blocks: Surface relief per layer, in blocks (0 = perfectly flat)
jlt_worldz.stacked.force_top_village: Force a village on the top layer (if its biome supports one)
jlt_worldz.customize.title: Customize Worldz
jlt_worldz.customize.allowed_biomes: Allowed biomes or #tags (one per line or comma-separated)
jlt_worldz.customize.starter_land.title: Starter Land
jlt_worldz.customize.starter_land.enable: Guarantee usable land beneath the starter biome
jlt_worldz.customize.nether_border.title: Nether Border
jlt_worldz.customize.border.tooltip: Limits how far the player can travel. Terrain generation past the border is unaffected -- set separately below under Exterior.
jlt_worldz.customize.end_border.title: End Border
jlt_worldz.customize.end_border.carry: Carry the Overworld's eventual radius into the End
jlt_worldz.customize.end_border.minimum_: Minimum radius (keeps the dragon fight winnable)
jlt_worldz.customize.ensure_end_portal: Ensure an End portal is reachable
jlt_worldz.customize.exterior.tooltip: Terrain shape beyond a boundary, independent of the border above: normal keeps ordinary infinite generation with access still limited by an enabled border; ocean/void replace generation itself out there.
jlt_worldz.customize.exterior.ocean_tran: Accessible ocean width inside outer radius
jlt_worldz.customize.layout.title: Coordinated World Layout
jlt_worldz.customize.layout.biomes: Weighted biomes (id or id@weight, one per line)
